description: The Lifeline: Wonthaggi to Cardinia pipeline route map.
methodology: Geographic Mapping: Traced the 84km industrial water artery using validated hub coordinates. Projection: Utilized a high-scale Mercator projection centered on the South Gippsland corridor to provide a focused 'infrastructure' view. Visual Design: Employed a metallic-blue line mark with an ordered sequence (Point_Order) to symbolize the forced migration of seawater toward urban reservoirs.
citation: AquaSure. (2026). Victorian Desalination Project Map. AquaSure.
